defect: AtomicFlushMemTablesToOutputFiles now treats any ShutdownInProgress status like a dropped CF and proceeds (s.ok() || s.IsShutdownInProgress(), and the Fsync loop overwrites s) to install flush results and superversions even when the DB is really shutting down, causing assertion failures on close.
reason: The fix restricts the ShutdownInProgress tolerance to the not-shutting-down case and reverts the install condition to s.ok(), exactly the conditions this change added.

defect: The added assert(fileOffset < dataSize) in BlockAccessCipherStream::Decrypt compares two unrelated quantities and fires on valid reads at offsets beyond the read length in debug builds.
reason: The fix simply removes the assert that this change added.

defect: The format string for write_buffer_size was mistyped as zu% (trailing lone percent, argument unused), giving wrong log output and a format warning/error.
reason: The fix corrects exactly the zu% typo introduced by this change to %zu.

defect: The new MyComparator uses rocksdb::Slice inside namespace ROCKSDB_NAMESPACE, which fails to compile when ROCKSDB_NAMESPACE is set to another name.
reason: The fix replaces the hard-coded rocksdb::Slice added by this change, repairing the alt-namespace CI build break.

defect: The local class PublishSeqCallback constructor parameter db_impl shadows the enclosing db_impl variable, breaking the build under -Wshadow -Werror.
reason: The fix renames the constructor parameter added by this change to remove the shadowing compile error.

defect: By no longer adjusting the base level size to L0 size while scoring L0 by size against an unadjusted target (and scaling by 10), the L0 score can grow very large so L0->L1 always wins and data gets stuck in L1.
reason: The fix, explicitly for a regression caused by this PR, rewrites the L0 score computation that this change altered together with the removed L0-based base-level adjustment.

defect: The added no-op IOSTATS_CPU_TIMER_GUARD(metric, env) discards env, leaving the env_ field in file_reader_writer.h unused so clang builds without thread-local support fail with -Wunused-private-field -Werror.
reason: The fix changes exactly the macro line this change added to consume env; the earlier missing-macro breakage was a different error that this change replaced with this one.

defect: The new ParseStrToUint64 names unused exception variables e in its catch clauses, which MSVC warns about and the warnings-as-errors Windows build rejects.
reason: The fix removes the unused catch variable names added by this change to repair the AppVeyor build.

defect: GetBlob asserts that the cached uncompressed blob size equals value_size, but value_size is the on-disk possibly compressed size, so the assert fails for compressed blobs.
reason: The fix removes the wrong assertion that this new file introduced, which crash tests hit.

defect: The new NeedsCompaction overloads take MutableCFOptions, which callers dereference from GetCurrentMutableCFOptions() before the super version is initialized, causing a SIGSEGV.
reason: The fix reverts the NeedsCompaction implementations added by this change to the score-based form without MutableCFOptions.

defect: The new test computes const int key_len from the uint64_t output_file_size_limit, an implicit 64-to-32-bit narrowing that clang rejects with -Wshorten-64-to-32 -Werror.
reason: The fix changes the type of the key_len line added by this change to repair the clang build.

defect: Dump() logs inplace_update_num_locks, which is not a member of MutableCFOptions at this revision, so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix removes the Log line referencing the nonexistent member that this change added.

defect: createNewSlice1 makes the Slice point at the buffer from GetByteArrayElements and then releases it, so the slice references JVM-owned or leaked memory (dangling pointer or leak).
reason: The fix copies the bytes into an owned buffer and releases the JNI elements with JNI_ABORT, repairing the memory handling this new file introduced.

defect: The new test uses std::array without including <array>, which fails to compile on mac with clang.
reason: The fix replaces the std::array this change added with a raw array to repair the mac build.

defect: NewTableReader dereferences table_properties_->user_defined_timestamps_persisted although table_properties_ can be null, crashing sst_dump in the crash test.
reason: The fix adds the null check to exactly the dereference this change introduced.

defect: The new AtomicCounter::WaitFor uses timeouts written 1 * 000 * 000 (octal zero) and an unsigned NowMicros() - start that underflows on clock skew, so it returns false spuriously and the test stays noisy.
reason: The fix rewrites the elapsed-time check of the WaitFor function this change added to stop the spurious failures.

defect: MixGraph now allocates char value_buffer[64 MB] on the stack, which overflows the stack on common platforms.
reason: The fix reduces the default_value_max introduced by this change to 1 MB to avoid the stack overflow.

defect: Renaming the bytewise comparator to rocksdb.BytewiseComparator changes the persisted comparator name, so existing databases fail to open with a comparator mismatch.
reason: The fix reverts exactly the name change made by this change to restore compatibility.

defect: GetChildren filters . and .. with strcmp on data.cFileName, which is a wide string in Windows Unicode builds, so that configuration fails to compile.
reason: The fix replaces the strcmp calls added by this change with the RX_FNCMP macro.

defect: Random rnd(4422 + id) narrows a size_t to the uint32_t Random constructor argument, breaking clang and Windows builds that treat the conversion warning as an error.
reason: The fix adds an explicit cast to the line this change introduced.

defect: Snappy_Uncompress passes the uninitialized ulength instead of input_length as the input size to snappy::GetUncompressedLength, giving undefined behaviour and wrong decompression.
reason: The fix corrects exactly that argument in the code this change added.

defect: AutoSkipCompressorWrapper stores opts_ as a const reference to a CompressionOptions that can die before the wrapper, causing stack-use-after-return in CompressBlock.
reason: The fix makes the wrapper copy the options, repairing the dangling reference introduced with this new class.

defect: GetBoundaryKeys takes only the first and last file per input level, which is wrong for overlapping L0 files, so IsBottommostLevel can wrongly return true and sequence numbers get zeroed, corrupting data.
reason: The fix makes GetBoundaryKeys scan all L0 files, repairing the function this change added.

defect: The new NoopTransformSeek test passes a temporary InternalKeyComparator to TableConstructor::Finish, which keeps a reference to it, so later use calls a pure virtual method and aborts.
reason: The fix keeps the comparator in a named local that outlives the reader, repairing the crash in the test this change added.

defect: ExternalTableOptions stores a const FileOptions reference, and this change binds it to a temporary FileOptions(topts.env_options) that dies at the end of the statement, leaving a dangling reference.
reason: The fix materializes the FileOptions in a local variable before constructing ExternalTableOptions.

defect: auto out_file_wrapper = WritableFileStringStreamAdapter(out_file) copy-initializes a non-movable stream buffer adapter, which gcc 4.8 rejects (use of deleted move constructor).
reason: The fix changes the line this change added to direct initialization, repairing the gcc-4.8 build.

defect: The change removed the LITE-specific constructor and made sst_file_manager_, mutex_ and error_handler_ unconditional members used only under #ifndef ROCKSDB_LITE, so LITE builds on macOS fail with -Wunused-private-field -Werror.
reason: The fix guards those members with ROCKSDB_LITE, repairing the build break introduced by this restructuring.

defect: compression is set to std::string(...).c_str() of a temporary, leaving a dangling pointer that is later read by fprintf.
reason: The fix replaces the temporaries introduced by this change with string literals after Valgrind flagged them.

defect: Compaction zeroes the sequence number in place in the key buffer owned by the input merging iterator, breaking the iterator's ordering assumptions and crashing db_stress.
reason: The fix copies the key before UpdateInternalKey, repairing the in-place update this change added.

defect: The new temperature flag defaults call TemperatureToString during static initialization, which reads a static map from another translation unit that may not be constructed yet, triggering an assertion.
reason: The fix hard-codes the defaults of the three flags this change added, removing the static-initialization-order problem.

defect: The new file-scope static std::string stats collides with local variables named stats in other files of the unity build, breaking it under -Wshadow -Werror.
reason: The fix renames the global stats introduced by this change to allstats.

defect: The capture-less lambda in the new Fold test uses the local constant kItersPerThread, which MSVC rejects, breaking the Windows build.
reason: The fix adds a by-reference capture to the lambda this change added.

defect: last_tombstone_start_user_key keeps a Slice of tombstone.start_key_ from a per-iteration RangeTombstone copy, which with user-defined timestamps points to freed memory (use-after-free).
reason: The fix takes the start key from the iterator instead, repairing the dangling Slice this change introduced.

defect: A copy-paste error conditions the second IncBgThreads on compaction_thread_pool_adjust_interval instead of continuous_verification_interval, so the background thread count is wrong.
reason: The fix corrects exactly the duplicated condition this change added.

defect: The new assertions expect internal aligned request sizes to be multiples of alignment(), which is computed from a buffered file and can differ from the direct-I/O reader's real alignment, so the test fails on Travis.
reason: The fix replaces alignment() with the reader's GetRequiredBufferAlignment in the assertions this change added; before them the mismatch was harmless.

defect: Moving table_properties_.reset(props) after PopulateIndex means props is leaked when PopulateIndex returns an error.
reason: The fix, which states that this PR opened the leak to one more error path, takes ownership of props in a shared_ptr up front.

defect: LevelFileIteratorState is forward-declared as struct but defined as class in version_set.cc, a mismatched tag that breaks the OSX clang build.
reason: The fix changes the forward declaration this change added from struct to class.

defect: The gtest macro ASSERT_GT is used in production code where it is not declared, so column_family.cc fails to compile.
reason: The fix replaces the ASSERT_GT this change added with a plain assert.

defect: The static const unordered_map variables are copy-list-initialized with = {}, which clang rejects because the library's default constructor is explicit.
reason: The fix drops the = {} initializers this new header introduced to repair the clang build.

defect: The batched multi-CF MultiGet passes &timestamps[i] to KeyContext even when timestamps is nullptr (as the old overload passes), giving bogus non-null pointers that are later written through.
reason: The fix adds the nullptr guard to this line, which this change wrote without the guard it used in the single-CF overload.
